sonnet.problem: The card says "That's Babylon, whose king took Judah into exile (2 Kings 25:21)." This turns the picture "Daughter of Babylon" into plain Babylon, which the passage never states. It also adds that the king took Judah into exile, but 2 Kings 25:21 says the king of Babylon struck them down and that Judah went into exile.
sonnet.rule: He says two names mean the same person only when a verse says so outright, and he gives that verse. / He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so.
